mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_import_log (tenant_id, import_session_id, file_name, total_records, success_records, failed_records, status, error_message, created_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{importSessionId}, #{fileName}, #{totalRecords}, #{successRecords}, #{failedRecords}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM customer_import_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND import_session_id = #{importSessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_import_log SET total_records = #{totalRecords}, success_records = #{successRecords}, failed_records = #{failedRecords}, status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
